Framework Optimization

Built for the Agentic Era.

LLMs and Autonomous Agents are phenomenal at writing logic, but they struggle with cascading complexity, fragile dependencies, and non-deterministic runtimes.
PalStack eliminates the noise so your Agents can ship safely.

The Struct is the Source of Truth

In standard stacks, an AI agent must juggle HTML templates, CSS files, Prisma schemas, SQL migrations, and endpoint implementations just to add a simple feature.

In PalStack, the Agent defines one Zig Struct. The framework's reflection layer automatically generates the SQLite memory mapping, auto-migrates the database schema, and type-checks the Reactivity bindings instantly. The cognitive load on the LLM is reduced by ~80%.

// Agent writes this:
const Invoice = struct {{
id: i32,
amount: f64,
is_paid: bool,
}};
// PalStack Engine handles:
✓ PRAGMA table_info("invoice")
✓ ALTER TABLE add columns
✓ JSON schema validation
0 Dp

Self-Healing Infrastructure

"Dependency hell" breaks autonomous workflows. If an NPM registry fails or a Webpack version conflicts, an Agent spins in a hallucination loop. PalStack has zero external file dependencies. No node_modules. It is a strictly controlled, deterministic deployment mechanism.

Cpt

Zero Runtime Hallucinations

Loosely typed JavaScript means Agents won't discover logic errors until they run End-to-End tests. PalStack's strict Zig compiler and Typed Radix Router guarantee that if an Agent's generated code compiles, it is mathematically memory-safe and structurally sound.
